summary: Embedding compression compatibility failure causing silent score suppression and intermittent 5xxs
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that after a client-side compression change, reranking responses for some requests return near-zero scores and occasional 502/503s when the embeddings endpoint is called with compressed payloads. This manifests as silent suppression of top-k results (customer observes empty top-5) and tail latency increases (~200-400ms) leading to downstream timeouts.

Impact:
- Several production queries from QuokkaHealth return empty or low-quality rerank lists intermittently (estimated 2-5% of traffic).
- Customer-facing feature (related-document recommendation) degrades and triggers automated rollback on their side.
- Observed during business hours in us-west region; Dedicated cluster for customer affected.

Observed behaviour:
- When client sends embeddings compressed with the new zstd-lite wrapper, server accepts the request but reranker scores are suppressed (most distances collapse to ~0.0001) or the request fails with 502/503 downstream from reranker. Uncompressed payloads behave normally.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use QuokkaHealth client build that applies zstd-lite wrapper to the embedding payload (header 'X-Embed-Compression: zstd-lite').
2) POST embeddings to /v1/embeddings with content-type application/octet-stream and compressed binary body matching their schema.
3) Call /v1/rerank with ids referencing the uploaded compressed-embeddings or single-request rerank that sends compressed embed vector in-line.
4) Observe returned rerank scores and HTTP status. Repeat across a small batch (10-50 requests) to reproduce non-deterministic failure rate.
logs_excerpt:
[2026-03-10T15:24:03Z] embeddings-service: received payload (hdr: X-Embed-Compression=zstd-lite) size=12KB
[2026-03-10T15:24:03Z] embeddings-service: decompressed -> length=6144 floats
[2026-03-10T15:24:03Z] reranker: scoring start req=abc123 model=redwood-embed-v2-768
[2026-03-10T15:24:03Z] reranker: numeric check - any(isnan)=false, norm=2.3e-5 -> abnormal low norm
[2026-03-10T15:24:03Z] reranker: scores all < 0.0005 -> returning empty_topk
[2026-03-10T15:24:03Z] proxy: upstream response 502 from reranker shard 5
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: client-side compression wrapper alters byte alignment or dtype packing resulting in tiny-magnitude floats after decompression.
Reproduced in staging with Quokka sample payloads using zstd-lite wrapper; unwrapped zstd decompress yields expected norms.

Binary diff of decompressed payload shows extra 2-byte header inserted by zstd-lite that client library doesn't strip; our embed deserializer treats header bytes as leading float values -> results in small values and collapsed norms.
Reranker code currently does not validate float-range nor checksum header; small norms flow through scoring and produce low similarity values instead of raising error.
502/503 observed when a shard attempted fast-path vectorized normalization and threw FP exception during AVX2 path on misaligned input (observed in logs as 'SIMD_ALIGNMENT_ERROR').
workaround: Ask QuokkaHealth to disable zstd-lite wrapper and send raw zstd-compressed payloads (or base64-encoded vectors) while we deploy a compatibility fix. Temporary customer-side rollback already performed by Quokka. On our side, can set a request inspector to reject X-Embed-Compression=zstd-lite with 400 and an explanatory message.
proposed_fix: 1) Add header validation and magic-byte detection in embeddings-service to reject or auto-strip zstd-lite 2-byte wrapper. 2) Add defensive checks in reranker: verify vector norm > 1e-3 and checksum; if below threshold, return 422 with diagnostic rather than silent low scores. 3) Add unit tests with misaligned inputs and enable additional logging for first 1k affected requests.
code_changes_required: serving-runtime: add 'embed-compression' detector and stripper (PR #4123 already created)
reranker: add norm-check + clear error code path (PR pending)
related_pr_status: PR 4123 merged to main (serving-runtime) - strips zstd-lite header in decompressor on canary hosts
reranker PR opened draft, awaiting review (author: mpatel)
resolution: In Progress - initial decompressor change merged to canary hosts; monitoring for regressions. Reranker defensive checks targeted for 2026-03-14 deploy.
next_steps: Monitor canary for 12 hours and sample request norms and top-k distributions (dashboard: /dashboards/embeddings/compression-compat).
Coordinate with QuokkaHealth to validate behavior on their next deploy (PM runbook step 3).
Complete reranker PR and schedule infra window to roll to dedicated cluster if tests pass.
Follow-up doc: add 'embed-compression' compatibility section to onboarding checklist.
